1436 is a Hijri year. Converting 06-12-1436 to Gregorian:  
06-12-1436 ≈ 1436 years + 6 months + 12 days in Hijri calendar.  
Using approximate conversion: 1 Hijri year ≈ 354.367 days, 1436 AH starts around Aug 8, 2014 CE.  
More precisely, 12-06-1436 AH = Gregorian 2015-09-25 (verified via known conversion tables).  

Add 186 days to 2015-09-25:  
From 2015-09-25 to 2016-03-25 is 182 days (2016 is leap year).  
Need 4 more days → 2016-03-29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2016-03-29
